agentStop.bash: mkdir -p "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}/logs" && printf '%s session ended in %s -- if this involved a non-trivial implementation, invoke pm-agent to document patterns/decisions before closing out.\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$PWD" >> "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}/logs/pm-agent-reminders.log"
agentStop.powershell: $base = if ($env:COPILOT_HOME) { $env:COPILOT_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.copilot' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $base 'logs') | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path (Join-Path $base 'logs/pm-agent-reminders.log') -Value ("{0} session ended in {1} -- if this involved a non-trivial implementation, invoke pm-agent to document patterns/decisions before closing out." -f (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'), $PWD)
